description: Declarative treatment pathway rules distilled from the curated knowledge cards. Each rule fires when all of its conditions hold for the derived patient profile. The same file is executed by the Python service and by the browser engine, so behaviour is identical in both. Rules propose options for MDT discussion; they never make decisions.

derived_fields.hr_positive: er_status in [positive, low] or pr_status == positive
derived_fields.triple_negative: er_status == negative and pr_status != positive and her2_status != positive
derived_fields.high_risk_nodes: positive_nodes >= 4, or positive_nodes >= 1 with grade 3 or tumour_size_mm >= 50

rules.title: Adjuvant tamoxifen for premenopausal hormone receptor positive disease
rules.text: Offer tamoxifen for at least five years, extending to ten years when recurrence risk remains meaningful.

rules.title: Add ovarian function suppression for higher risk premenopausal disease
rules.text: Discuss ovarian function suppression combined with an aromatase inhibitor or tamoxifen (SOFT and TEXT), weighing menopausal side effects.

rules.title: Aromatase inhibitor for postmenopausal hormone receptor positive disease
rules.text: Offer an aromatase inhibitor as initial adjuvant endocrine therapy, with a baseline bone density scan; tamoxifen is an option for low risk disease or intolerance.

rules.title: Tamoxifen for male breast cancer
rules.text: Tamoxifen is the preferred endocrine therapy; avoid an aromatase inhibitor without testicular suppression. Offer genetic testing.

rules.title: Adjuvant abemaciclib for high risk node positive disease
rules.text: Patient meets monarchE style high risk criteria: consider two years of abemaciclib with endocrine therapy, monitoring for diarrhoea and neutropenia.

rules.title: Adjuvant ribociclib for stage II to III disease
rules.text: NATALEE population: consider three years of ribociclib with a nonsteroidal aromatase inhibitor, with ECG and liver function monitoring.

rules.title: Use a genomic assay to guide chemotherapy
rules.text: A multigene recurrence score (for example Oncotype DX or MammaPrint) would refine the absolute benefit of adjuvant chemotherapy.

rules.title: Recurrence score 25 or below in a postmenopausal woman
rules.text: TAILORx and RxPONDER found no meaningful chemotherapy benefit in this group; endocrine therapy alone is usually appropriate.

rules.title: Intermediate recurrence score in a younger or premenopausal woman
rules.text: Some chemotherapy benefit was seen in women aged 50 or younger and in premenopausal node positive women; discuss chemotherapy or ovarian suppression.

rules.title: High recurrence score
rules.text: Recurrence score above 25: adjuvant anthracycline and taxane based chemotherapy is recommended alongside endocrine therapy.

rules.title: Chemotherapy with trastuzumab for HER2 positive early disease
rules.text: Offer chemotherapy with trastuzumab (12 months standard, 6 months non inferior in PERSEPHONE); add pertuzumab for node positive disease. Neoadjuvant treatment is preferred for tumours above 20 mm or node positive disease.

rules.title: T-DM1 for residual disease after neoadjuvant HER2 therapy
rules.text: Residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant HER2 directed therapy: switch to trastuzumab emtansine for 14 cycles (KATHERINE).

rules.title: Cardiac surveillance during HER2 targeted therapy
rules.text: Baseline LVEF and repeat assessment around every three months; pause treatment if LVEF falls below 50 percent with a significant drop.

rules.title: Reduced ejection fraction before HER2 therapy
rules.text: LVEF below 50 percent: seek cardio oncology review before trastuzumab and avoid anthracyclines where possible.

rules.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy with pembrolizumab for stage II to III triple negative disease
rules.text: KEYNOTE-522 regimen: neoadjuvant carboplatin, paclitaxel and pembrolizumab, then anthracycline and cyclophosphamide, then adjuvant pembrolizumab, with immune toxicity monitoring.

rules.title: Escalation for residual triple negative disease
rules.text: Residual invasive triple negative disease: consider adjuvant capecitabine (CREATE-X), or olaparib if a germline BRCA carrier.

rules.title: Adjuvant olaparib for germline BRCA carriers
rules.text: High risk HER2 negative disease in a BRCA carrier: one year of adjuvant olaparib improved invasive disease free and overall survival (OlympiA).

rules.title: Adjuvant bisphosphonate
rules.text: Offer an adjuvant bisphosphonate (zoledronic acid or oral clodronate) after a dental check.

rules.title: Whole breast or chest wall radiotherapy schedule
rules.text: Where radiotherapy is indicated without nodal irradiation, 26 Gy in five fractions over one week is the recommended schedule (FAST-Forward).

rules.title: Discuss omission of radiotherapy
rules.text: PRIME II population: omitting radiotherapy after breast conserving surgery modestly increases local recurrence without affecting survival, provided endocrine therapy is taken for five years.

rules.title: Postmastectomy and nodal radiotherapy
rules.text: Four or more involved nodes: recommend chest wall and regional nodal radiotherapy.

rules.title: Axillary de escalation
rules.text: With one or two positive sentinel nodes after breast conserving surgery and planned whole breast radiotherapy, axillary dissection can usually be omitted (Z0011), or axillary radiotherapy used (AMAROS).

rules.title: Offer germline genetic testing
rules.text: Germline BRCA1 and BRCA2 testing is indicated; results affect surgery, PARP inhibitor eligibility and family cascade testing.

rules.title: Fertility counselling before systemic therapy
rules.text: Offer fertility counselling and preservation before gonadotoxic treatment; GnRH agonist protection during chemotherapy can be discussed.

rules.title: Geriatric assessment
rules.text: Base treatment intensity on a geriatric assessment of comorbidity, function and life expectancy rather than chronological age.

rules.title: Pregnancy
rules.text: Trastuzumab and tamoxifen are contraindicated in pregnancy; anthracycline chemotherapy can be given in the second and third trimesters with specialist obstetric input.

rules.title: Reduced performance status
rules.text: ECOG 3 or above: prioritise symptom control and the least toxic effective therapy; most trials will exclude this patient.

rules.title: ER low tumour
rules.text: ER low (1 to 10 percent) tumours often behave like triple negative disease; discuss whether triple negative pathways such as neoadjuvant immunotherapy are more appropriate.

rules.title: First line endocrine therapy with a CDK4/6 inhibitor
rules.text: Offer an aromatase inhibitor or fulvestrant with palbociclib, ribociclib or abemaciclib, with ovarian suppression if premenopausal.

rules.title: Visceral crisis
rules.text: Visceral crisis: chemotherapy first to achieve rapid response, then reconsider endocrine based therapy.

rules.title: Biomarker testing after CDK4/6 inhibitor progression
rules.text: Test for PIK3CA, AKT1, PTEN and ESR1 alterations to select the next line (capivasertib, alpelisib or inavolisib combinations, elacestrant, or everolimus with exemestane).

rules.title: PI3K pathway altered disease
rules.text: PIK3CA altered: fulvestrant with capivasertib or alpelisib (or an inavolisib combination where available); monitor glucose and rash.

rules.title: ESR1 mutated disease
rules.text: ESR1 mutation detected: the oral SERD elacestrant improved progression free survival (EMERALD).

rules.title: First line HER2 positive metastatic disease
rules.text: Offer pertuzumab, trastuzumab and a taxane (CLEOPATRA).

rules.title: Second line HER2 positive metastatic disease
rules.text: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is the preferred next line (DESTINY-Breast03); watch for interstitial lung disease.

rules.title: Brain metastases in HER2 positive disease
rules.text: Consider tucatinib with trastuzumab and capecitabine (HER2CLIMB) alongside local therapy such as stereotactic radiosurgery.

rules.title: HER2 low metastatic disease
rules.text: Trastuzumab deruxtecan is an option after prior chemotherapy (DESTINY-Breast04) or after endocrine therapy in chemotherapy naive disease (DESTINY-Breast06).

rules.title: PD-L1 positive metastatic triple negative disease
rules.text: PD-L1 CPS 10 or more: first line pembrolizumab with chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-355).

rules.title: Pretreated metastatic triple negative disease
rules.text: After prior chemotherapy, sacituzumab govitecan improved survival (ASCENT).

rules.title: PARP inhibitor for BRCA carriers with metastatic disease
rules.text: Olaparib or talazoparib are options for germline BRCA carriers with HER2 negative metastatic disease.

rules.title: Confirm biology and integrate palliative care
rules.text: Biopsy a metastasis where feasible to confirm ER, PR and HER2, and involve palliative care early for symptom control.

rules.title: Screen for clinical trials
rules.text: Every patient should be considered for clinical trial participation at the MDT; see the trial screening panel for candidates.
